_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your own Tezos wallet addresses. Wallet addresses are public on-chain anyway, but it's your choice whether to commit config.json to a public fork.
_custom_format_comment: Only used if output_format is set to 'custom' above. Define your own CSV column order/headers here to match any tax platform's required format. 'field' must be one of: date, sent_amount, sent_currency, received_amount, received_currency, txhash, fee_amount, fee_currency, description - or 'static:SomeValue' for a fixed literal in every row. date_format is a Python strftime pattern (see README) - omit it to keep the default 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.
